6.3
rsAggregateInQueryParameterExpression
rsAggregateInQueryParameterExpression is a critical error that will occur when one of the aggregate
functions other than Previous, RunningValue, or RowNumber or a Lookup, LookupSet, or MultiLookup
function is specified within a QueryParameter.Value instance.
